lines.zh: 红肉突擦过叶面，留下湿痕。
lines.en: My red tubercles leave a wet trail on the leaf.

lines.zh: 黑身子一弓一伸，贴叶前行。
lines.en: My black body arches and stretches along the leaf.
I work my way round the leaf edge.
I shift toward the middle of the leaf.
I step on the tiny veins.
I crawl slowly toward the shoot.
I lift my head to test ahead.
I crawl into the shade under the leaf.
When the leaf stirs, I stop and wait.
I shift another small distance.
I cross a thick vein.
I've found a secure spot.
I crawl to the fork of the twig.
I pause at the leaf's edge.
I contract, then move on.
I've moved to a fresher leaf.
I press flat to the leaf, still.
I'm chewing a tender leaf.
I hide myself by a vein.

lines.zh: 我整日啃马兜铃的叶缘。
lines.en: All day I gnaw the edge of a Dutchman pipe leaf.

lines.zh: 我颜色和叶子几乎一样。
lines.en: My color nearly matches the leaf.
I stop and do nothing.
Sunlight comes through a gap in the leaves.

lines.zh: 我抬着头，听树上的动静。
lines.en: Head raised, I listen to the tree.
I coil in the middle of the leaf.
I've grown a little more.

lines.zh: 叶子有点皱了，我该换了。
lines.en: This leaf is wilting; I should move.
I keep still, afraid of being seen.
You're below; I'm on the leaf.
I look up at you, just once.
Your hand is coming over.
Don't tear this leaf away.
I eat leaves, not you.

lines.zh: 我可以被搬到别的叶子上。
lines.en: I can be moved to another leaf.

lines.zh: 你的手指比我的身子大很多。
lines.en: Your finger is much bigger than me.
I tilt my head and look at you slowly.

lines.zh: 你身上没有叶子的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of leaves.
Ring after ring of segments run down my body.
I curl into a ring.
That bent my body.

lines.zh: 叶面太滑，我滑了一小段。
lines.en: The leaf is slick; I slipped a little.
My pattern keeps the birds off.
A little fluid seeps from me.

lines.zh: 我从叶子背面慢慢探出来。
lines.en: I slowly emerge from the underside of the leaf.
The leaf's still here, so I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我躲到叶背下面，别踩这片叶子。
lines.en: I hide under the leaf; do not step on it.
Off the leaf, and I starve.

lines.zh: 别戳我的红肉突，会渗汁。
lines.en: Do not poke my red tubercles; they ooze.
A fresh leaf! My favorite.
You've set it beside me.
This leaf is tender and smells good.
The edge of this leaf suits my mouth.

lines.zh: 咬下去，汁水在颚间发苦。
lines.en: One bite, and bitter sap fills my jaws.
Don't move the leaf; I'm about to bite.
I gnaw my way along the edge.
With a leaf, I'm content.

lines.zh: 换到新叶上，我能长快些。
lines.en: On a new leaf I'll grow faster.

lines.zh: 你把叶柄垂低些，我才够得到。
lines.en: Lower the leaf stem so I can reach it.
You bumped the leaf and I swayed.
I gripped the vein and stayed on.

lines.zh: 叶子被你碰得一斜，我抓紧了。
lines.en: You tilted the leaf; I gripped tight.

lines.zh: 我这么小，几乎撞不到你。
lines.en: I'm so small I barely touch you.
When the leaf sways, I stop.
Your shadow has blocked the light.

lines.zh: 我往叶荫那面挪，躲开你的影。
lines.en: I move to the shaded side, away from your shadow.
Off the leaf, I can't survive.
Knocked away, I crawl back onto the vein.
The twig is still swaying.
Another caterpillar is nearby.
We gnaw this leaf together.
It's a little thicker than me.

lines.zh: 两条黑虫把红点对着红点。
lines.en: Two black caterpillars face red spot to red spot.
Pupation time is near.

lines.zh: 我的叶子，你也想咬一口？
lines.en: My leaf — you want a bite too?

lines.zh: 我们并排咬住同一条叶脉。
lines.en: Side by side, we bite the same vein.
The wind comes; we sway together.
Soon we'll both change.
The wood will hold more wings.

lines.zh: 我只含得住叶屑，别的都掉。
lines.en: I can only hold leaf crumbs; the rest drops.
I touch it with my mouthparts.
I'll eat leaf scraps too.
It's in the way on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我啃过的地方，叶脉还留着。
lines.en: Where I fed, the veins are still there.

lines.zh: 叶柄太硬，我的颚磨不动。
lines.en: The stem is too hard for my jaws.
I shove it to the leaf edge.
I only want that leaf.
I crawl slowly over it.
I retreat to the leaf's middle.
I want that tender leaf.
I crawl that way.
This one's old; I'll switch.

lines.zh: 那片马兜铃的嫩尖，我要了。
lines.en: That young pipevine tip is mine.
No one's eating the leaf ahead.
I start moving along the leaf vein.
The new shoot at the tip is the tenderest.
Belly empty, I creep toward the leaf.

lines.zh: 叶脉的方向，我闻得出来。
lines.en: I can smell which way the vein runs.
A vein runs all the way there.
I measure my way forward segment by segment.
A little further and I'll reach.
I crawl along the leaf edge.
A thick vein lies across; I must go around.

lines.zh: 裳凤蝶的幼虫，只吃这一种叶。
lines.en: This birdwing larva eats only one leaf.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，量还有多远。
lines.en: I raise my head to measure how far is left.
No hurry; crawling will do.
I go around a water bead.
My jaws are open; half an inch to go.
I contract, then continue.

lines.zh: 我用红角顶开挡路的叶脉。
lines.en: I shove the blocking vein aside with a red horn.

lines.zh: 我咬住叶柄，把整片压低。
lines.en: I bite the stem and pull the whole leaf down.
My jaws can only chew through leaf flesh.
That bit through the leaf.
I push at what blocks me.
My mouthparts are too small for the hard stalk.

lines.zh: 我的身体一伸一缩，慢慢爬。
lines.en: My body stretches and contracts as I crawl.
You felt nothing, I suppose.

lines.zh: 黑皮上的红肉突顶了你一下。
lines.en: The red tubercles on my black skin poke you.
I'm tired; I stop.
I've hatched from the egg.

lines.zh: 我落在马兜铃叶上，先咬一口。
lines.en: I land on a pipevine leaf and bite in first.
A common birdwing caterpillar, here.

lines.zh: 卵壳还粘在背上，我就开吃。
lines.en: Eggshell still stuck to me, I start eating.
This leaf is mine.
I raise my head to the wood.
I'm small, and growing fast.
I found a safe leaf underside.
Leaves are plentiful in this forest.
First I chew out a little hole.

lines.zh: 热气一烘，我身上都干了。
lines.en: The heat dries my whole body.
The veins are too smooth to grip.
Soaked in water, I can't move.
The blast blows me off the leaf.
Without leaves, I won't last.

lines.zh: 彩光扫过，我的肉突全缩了。
lines.en: A colored flash passes; my tubercles all retract.
No leaves; I'm starving.
The thunder shakes the leaves hard.
There's not a single leaf here.
